name: Bleeding
description: Losing the red stuff. 1d4 damage per stack each round.

name: Burning
description: On fire. 1d6 fire damage each round.

name: Poisoned
description: 1d4 poison damage each round and -2 to your power rolls.

name: Stunned
description: Loses their next turn and drools a little.

name: Blinded
description: -5 to your power rolls, and anything swinging at you gets an edge.

name: Slowed
description: One less AP each turn, and anything swinging at you gets an edge.

name: Hasted
description: An extra AP each turn, and anything swinging at you takes a bane.

name: Feared
description: Can only try to flee or cower. Anything swinging at you gets an edge.

name: Charmed
description: Won't attack whoever charmed them. Thinks they're neat.

name: Shielded
description: Absorbs damage. Reduces all incoming damage by 3.

name: Regenerating
description: Heals 1d6 each round. Gross to watch.

name: Confused
description: Attacks a random target, possibly a friend, possibly the floor. Anything swinging at you gets an edge.

name: Invisible
description: Can't be targeted until you attack. Enemies swing at where you probably are. +5 stealth.

name: Braced
description: Feet planted, guard up: a double bane on anything swinging at you, and you can't be shoved. Ends when your next turn starts.

name: Tethered
description: Tied in place by Echo's rope. Can't move or run, and anything swinging at it gets an edge.

name: Politely Declined
description: You said no thank you twice, and meant it. It can't bring itself to attack you.

name: Sorting
description: Busy re-filing the thing you returned. Loses its turns.

name: Parked
description: Has parked itself, as the ticket demands. Loses its turns until it remembers it's a kraken.

name: Warded
description: A legal-looking shimmer: +2 guard, and anything that hits you in melee takes 2 back.

name: Tenderized
description: Softened up like a cheap steak: -2 armor and -2 guard, so everything lands cleaner.

name: Bad Feeling
description: The hair on your neck is on the job: traps are spotted as you walk in. Counts down per room.
